evidence.title: GitHub - darkroomengineering/lenis: Smooth scroll as it should be · GitHub

name: Lenis
summary: Lightweight smooth scroll library with React, Vue and Framer packages and a scroll-snap plugin.
description: A dependency-free smooth scroll library that wraps the browser's own scroll, so position: sticky, anchor links and accessibility keep working. One instance handles vertical, horizontal and nested scrolling and drives WebGL scroll scenes, GSAP ScrollTrigger and parallax from a single loop; prefers-reduced-motion is honored by default. Packages exist for React, Vue, Framer and scroll snapping.
contains: dependency-free, a few KB with zero runtime dependencies
vertical, horizontal and nested scrolling from one instance
packages: lenis, lenis/react, lenis/vue, lenis/framer and lenis/snap
settings, properties, methods and events documented (lerp, duration, scrollTo, raf, syncTouch)
syncs smooth scroll with WebGL scenes, GSAP ScrollTrigger and parallax
